title: SMOK Mavic Pro RF Replacement Pods 0.8ohm 2ml - 3 Pods
description: The Smok Mavic RF Pro Replacement Pods are specifically designed for use with the Smok Mavic RF Pro Vape Kit, ensuring a seamless and flavourful vaping experience. Each pod boasts a 2ml e-liquid capacity and is equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, optimized for delivering rich, consistent flavours and smooth vapour production. Refilling these pods is straightforward and mess-free, thanks to the convenient side-fill system. The integrated 0.8ohm mesh coil ensures efficient vaporisation and enhances the taste of your favourite e-liquids. The pods connect securely to the device with a magnetic connection, making replacements quick and easy. Each pack contains three replacement pods, providing excellent value and ensuring you always have spares on hand. These pods are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping and are perfect for use with nicotine salt e-liquids. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
